handbookNote: Colorado Real Estate license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 290 live questions existed only in D1. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 290 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 15 bucket files under co_re_salesperson_questions/ (Advertising/Marketing Disclosures/Consumer Notices 12, Affiliated Business Arrangements & Disciplinary Hearing Procedure 20, Broker Compensation/Commissions/Referral Fees 14, Brokerage Relationships & Agency Duties 33, Continuing Education Requirements 13, Contracts/Standard Forms & Transaction-Closing Requirements 21, Definitions & Statutory Framework 24, Disciplinary Grounds & Investigations 23, Employing Broker Supervision & Brokerage Firm Policies 14, License Issuance/Application Review & E&O Insurance 24, License Renewal/Status Changes & Fees 18, Licensing Requirements: Education/Experience/Examination 31, Real Estate Commission/Division of Real Estate & Rulemaking Authority 10, Trust & Escrow Accounts 22, Violations/Third-Party Liability & License Enforcement Actions 11) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. IMPORTANT LICENSING-STRUCTURE NOTE: Colorado is UNUSUAL among states -- it does NOT have a separate 'salesperson' license tier at all under current law. Every Colorado real estate licensee holds a 'real estate broker' license (there is no lower salesperson rung); the practical distinction is between an 'employing broker' (runs/supervises a brokerage) and a broker who works under one. This track is named 'co_re_salesperson' in this project's exam_type convention (a naming choice from an earlier build session, not to be changed as part of this backfill) but its content should be grounded in Colorado's actual real estate BROKER licensing law -- Colorado Revised Statutes (C.R.S.) Title 12, Article 10, Part 2 (Real Estate Brokers) and the Colorado Real Estate Commission's Rules (4 CCR 725-1) -- since that is the only license this exam content can accurately represent. Regulatory framework: the Colorado Real Estate Commission, part of the Division of Real Estate within the Department of Regulatory Agencies (DORA). This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=74, pass_percent=71.6) reflects the currently-tracked exam mechanics. Bucket agents should independently verify current exam vendor (commonly PSI), exact statute/rule section numbers, and current item counts via live fetch of leg.colorado.gov / colorado.gov/dora/real-estate rather than assuming. Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'co_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
